action: Open a bill from the list
user_goal: I want one bill's details and actions in one place
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
expected: Bills is a full-width list with Add a bill at the top; a row opens /bills/<id> with a right-hand panel of about 420px holding the bill's details, Edit and Remove

Forwarding address (or the words that forwarding is not set up) is on this page

action: Remove a bill from its page

preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Press Remove, read the question and press Keep
expected: Keep changes nothing; confirming removes the whole monthly series, closes the panel and returns to /bills without Rent
